notes.title: Update 1.5.2

tags.bug: - Fixed barrels in SPACE, player could get stuck in them;
- Fixed the "ghost trail" effect on some materials caused by AA;
- Fixed the acid pool which was sometimes killing players for no reason (synchronized between server and client);
- Fixed the H health which was desynchronized between client and server;
- Fixed menu persistence;
- Fixed menu back button;
- Fixed the colliders in the borders of SPACE map;
- Fixed key bindings;
- Fixed server refresh button;
- Fixed killed by self text not appearing;
- Fixed 0 health bug;

tags.balance_change: - Changed Plasma Rifle damage from 10 to 15;
- Changed Sting Gun damage from 7 to 10;
- Changed Melee damage from 60 to 80;
- Changed initial White-Hot ammo from 24 to 40;

tags.feature: - Made players more visible, especially in SPACE;
